snippet.title: Clicky Islands - Announce Trailer - Pocketpair Publishing
snippet.description:
🖤Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4178790/Clicky_Islands/

Introducing Clicky Islands! 

A hyper addictive game from Poland, made by just 2 devs! 

Clicky Islands combines incremental gameplay with clicker elements and city building! Build your town click by click, and then automate tasks as your town grows!

Demo available today!

▼About the Game
Title: Clicky Islands
Genre: Incremental / City Builder / Strategy / Casual
Players: 1 
Release Date: 2026
Pricing: To be announced
Platforms: PC - Steam (Windows / SteamOS+Linux)
Languages: English, German, Polish, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese
Steam Store page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4178790/Clicky_Islands/
Developer: Karrot Games
Publisher: Pocketpair Publishing

●About Pocketpair Publishing

Pocketpair Publishing partners with indie developers and small studios, offering funding, development support, and publishing to help bring their games to life.
 
If you’d like to contact Pocketpair Publishing, please use the dedicated inquiry form on the official Pocketpair website.

▼Pocketpair Publishing inquiry form
https://www.pocketpair.jp/publishing
